events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died from his injuries on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his tragic death, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. We're remembering the legendary artist today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. His legacy continues to inspire generations of artists.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: The album cover that launched a thousand theories. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 this year! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders. What's your top track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo banger?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, with the single released in the US in October 1971 and in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The timeless album continues to resonate. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod's Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, his comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, from complications due to AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! This pivotal Beatles album changed everything. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since we lost a true visionary. His music and message continue to inspire hope and peace worldwide.
